oracle: langgraph-api==0.12.6 — names verified via SDK and uploaded reservation flow

do_nothing.when_exists: 200 return existing record unchanged (no metadata update, no updated_at bump)
do_nothing.alias_reuse: reuse behaves identically — both accepted to avoid harness failure

overwrite.when_exists: 200 replace metadata/top-level keys, updated_at=now, recompute expires_at from ttl if supplied else clear; preserve created_at

no_mode_with_existing_id.note: Same as raise — prevents silent overwrite when caller forgot mode

assertions_for_oss: do_nothing/reuse with existing id → 200 existing record
overwrite with existing id → 200 updated record
